statement: N-0071 follow-up to D-0065 (domain rule, Warren's call; not picked). Question: what value (amount) should a partly shipped open line contribute to value totals, now that its quantity counts the remainder? Evidence (cip read-only, N0071_IMPL.md Round 2): 10 partial lines, open 904 units, shipped twins 568, remainder 336; all 10 have an amount; none is in any shipping KPI cohort today (current incoming, arriving week, overdue, landed), so value impact today is 0. Built now: (a). Options: (a) keep D-0057 for value: the open line adds no amount (built; units and value can disagree for these lines); (b) pro-rata: amount x remainder / open quantity; (c) full stored amount (double counts the shipped part's value). Assumptions: the open row's amount is the whole order line's value. Impact: shipping KPI value-by-currency only (no other D-0065 reader totals amount). Reversibility: high, read-side only, no fact rewrite. Resolving step: Warren picks (a)/(b)/(c); (b) is one CASE in shipment_strict_pair.twin_remainder plus the KPI amount sum.
